versions.changelog:
Contract Renewal Agent v1.0.0

- Initial release of the contract-renewal-agent skill
- Manage and track contract renewals with local JSON storage (no API keys required)
- Features include expiration date tracking, renewal reminders, and contract status management
- Analyzes uploaded contracts to extract relevant renewal clauses
- Generates tailored renewal proposals and tracks negotiation progress
- Provides CLI and skill-based interaction for ease of use
